recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, gritty urban scene featuring a central figure framed by a bright doorway against a dark, textured cinder block wall with graffiti. The composition is defined by a cool blue color cast and a vertical Japanese-style obi strip on the left margin.
coreVisualRelationships: High-key silhouette framing the subject against a low-key textured background
Vertical alignment of the left-side information panel against the square image format
Contrast between the clean geometric lines of the doorway and the chaotic textures of the wall
Cool blue shadows balanced by warm, blown-out highlights in the doorway
coreInvariants: Blown-out white light source behind the subject
Cinder block wall with dark, scribbled graffiti

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, full-body, framed within a vertical doorway occupying the middle third of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white rectangle of the doorway serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright central figure, move to the top-right text, then sweep down the textured wall to the left-side vertical panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark, textured negative space on the right side to balance the bright center.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and slate blue in the shadows and midtones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the backlight and doorway interior.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for the primary English text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment with high value contrast between the subject and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a monochromatic blue bias in the dark areas

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Modern geometric sans-serif for English paired with heavy, traditional Gothic for Japanese vertical text.

preserve: Wide tracking of the main title
Vertical orientation of the left panel text
avoid: Script or handwritten fonts for the main titles

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and clean uppercase structure.
Provides the necessary geometric balance and uniform stroke weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty urban scene of a man in denim leaning in a doorway. The doorway is filled with bright, blown-out white light. The surrounding wall is dark blue cinder blocks with faint black graffiti. Apply a heavy film grain and a cool blue color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a pale green vertical strip on the far left. Place large vertical black Japanese characters on the strip. Place a single line of golden-yellow geometric sans-serif text in the top right corner with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the color cast predominantly cool blue?
Is the central doorway significantly brighter than the rest of the image?
Is the English text tracked out widely?
Does the left panel contain vertical text elements?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grade
Amount of graffiti detail on the wall
Width of the left-side obi strip
Brightness of the backlight in the doorway
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and album titles
Corporate logos and record label branding
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grain is consistent across the image
Check that the yellow text is legible against the dark background
Verify the vertical alignment of the left-side panel elements
Confirm the subject is framed clearly by the light source
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Gritty Backdrop + High-Key Doorway Framing + Cool Blue Grade + Vertical Left-Side Information Panel + Geometric Sans-Serif Display Type
